content: datarequests.org (fetched): GDPR request generators for access, erasure, rectification, marketing objection, plus a v2 complaint/admonition generator; searchable company database with user-addable entries; letters generated then sent by the user themselves; 'we never get to see your data'; one-month deadline surfaced with follow-up reminders; guidance on escalating to supervisory authorities. Closest structural analogue to Module A.
